_meta.summary: V7P2P1 failed-archive reproducibility config: keep failure evidence under docs/versions/v7p2p1 and roll mainline back to v7p1 for next iteration.
commands: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v7p1 --episodes 150 --out v7p1_smoke150 --device cuda --progress
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v7p1 --models v7p1_smoke150 --runs 3 --out v7p1_smoke150
notes: Standard workflow: pre-version GitHub snapshot -> smoke150 (train) + runs=3 (infer) -> go/no-go.
If smoke has no clear gain, stop full evaluation, archive as failed version, and rollback to previous stable version.
Current rollback target after v7p2p1 is v7p1.
